svg.title: Hidden Markov model: z_1\sim \mathrm{Categorical}(\pi); z_t\mid z_{t-1}\sim \mathrm{Categorical}(A_{z_{t-1},:}); y_t\mid z_t\sim \mathcal{N}(\mu_{z_t},\;\sigma^2); \pi=\left[0.5, 0.5\right]; A_{0,:}=\left[0.9, 0.1\right]; A_{1,:}=\left[0.15, 0.85\right]; \mu=\left[-1.5, 1.5\right]; \sigma=0.45; 30 time steps.; state 0 = quiet, state 1 = active
